# AI Usage Notes

## 1. AI Assistance Used

I used AI tools (ChatGPT) during the development of this project for:
- Project structure suggestions
- Express.js API implementation guidance
- API endpoint design ideas
- Debugging assistance
- README documentation improvement

## 2. AI Generated vs Developer Written Code

AI assistance was used for:
- Initial boilerplate suggestions
- API route structure recommendations
- Error handling suggestions

I reviewed, modified, and integrated the code based on my understanding.

The following parts were written and validated by me:
- Project setup
- Express server configuration
- Expense CRUD API implementation
- API testing using Postman
- GitHub repository setup

## 3. Validation and Changes Made

I tested the API using:
- Postman
- PowerShell curl commands

I verified:
- Adding expenses
- Fetching all expenses
- Updating expenses
- Deleting expenses
- Server startup commands

I modified AI suggestions where needed to match the assignment requirements.

## 4. AI Suggestions Not Used

Some suggestions were not used because:
- Database integration was not required for this assignment.
- Additional complexity was avoided to keep the solution simple and aligned with requirements.
